title: Commanders DT Johnny Newton to miss significant time after pec surgery

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Commanders DT Johnny Newton to miss significant time after pec surgery
sources.description: Commanders defensive tackle Johnny Newton went to see a specialist in New York this week about his pectoral injury and the result of that meeting will be an extended absence from the lineup.
